rounds.notes:
[Sköldkastning](item_a6c36dee-d961-428b-b27c-93ba5ef377d8) is the core of this build, synergizing with the rest of our powers and many items. For now, mostly just use it to keep Inspire uptime as close to 100% as you can. Right now, you're pretty fragile and most characters can out-damage you. 

A lot of Brigs try to face-tank without realizing they are very mortal and can die quickly in the main game. The first few rounds you're pretty much the same, so don't try to be a tank, just stay in the back while still being able to heal and hit people around corners with your boomerang, and farm stadium cash early to become a monster later. 

NOTE: You can "store" your next use of [Sköldkastning](item_a6c36dee-d961-428b-b27c-93ba5ef377d8), as there's no time limit to it. When you use shield bash, the next time you use your primary fire or quick melee, whenever that is, you'll also shoot out the shield boomerang. This means you can shield boomerang, bash, then shield boomerang immediately after if you have it saved up, which really helps later on for damage and uptime of your powers and items. 

If you're like me and like to spam your primary fire on Brig when you're not doing anything, now is the time to forcefully unlearn that habit LOL

---

If an item is marked as IMPORTANT with a star, don't replace or sell that item unless there's something in the round notes saying you can.

Now you really want to do your best to hit as many people as much as possible with your Shield Boomerang - while not dying, obviously - even if you already activated inspire, as the more people you hit the more often you'll get your ult. 

---

Though it doesn't count as "using" an ability for items like [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) or [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8), [Sköldkastning](item_a6c36dee-d961-428b-b27c-93ba5ef377d8)'s damage DOES count as "ability damage". 

This means that any time your shield boomerang passes through an enemy, (both going out AND coming back!), you get 3% extra ult charge with [Scavenged Steel](item_fb9d2d13-db05-46fa-b3c6-07495b1872a4). We don't need [Catalytic Crystal](item_3e3f4f77-cdf8-4dda-a5b0-2fb9390aefc4) with this build, because with this alone you can build up your rally really fast.

Note that you can't get ult charge this way *during* your Rally.

Now, with [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0), you and your team will be more tanky as you spam ability damage to the enemy team, likely even getting higher mitigated damage than one or both tanks each round. 

Or, your rally will be even stronger if you pick up [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee). 

---

### POWERS 
Either power option this round is really good, and what you don't pick here you'll get as your next power anyways, since they synergize so well. 
- [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0): Interestingly, despite not counting for items as "using" an ability, [Sköldkastning](item_a6c36dee-d961-428b-b27c-93ba5ef377d8)'s damage counts as triggering inspire using an ability, and so every time it hits an enemy is another stack of overhealth for you and your team. Obviously, this is great for you, since you're trying to hit the enemies as often as you can anyways. (Fun fact: one of the first few games I was testing out the viability of this power, I got 64k mitigated damage the final *round* alone.)
- [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee): Quicker, better rally, which you should be getting pretty often already. Also good to keep in mind I see a lot of Brigs choose this second, so if you're facing another Brig and don't want to risk getting your ult slower initially, that is a good time to pick this.

---

### ITEMS 
Nothing super interesting for items, just building up some [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) so you can use your abilities more often, and thus get more ability damage in.

They're not marked Important, but I wouldn't recommend replacing any of the items with [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) with the optional items, they're just there if you end up having way more cash this round.

round_upgrades.notes: don't forget this is a great item if you're facing enemies with a lot of negative effects, like an Ashe with a lot of burns

rounds.notes:
From now on you just get consistently stronger with each round. Right now, building up more [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and survivability to do what you've been doing, but better. 

---

[Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) gives you more of everything you want in your build, and [Vitality Amplifier](item_6b52b1c9-a924-4a93-8545-a1c205cf6927) can be super helpful in a pinch, and gives you AP when you aren't.

However, if you can't afford those, or want to focus survivability first, then [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) combined with [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) (if you're facing enemies focused on [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power)/[Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed)) are also good picks. Also, if you chose [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0), this also adds to your ovehealth gain, as it's based on your max hp.

[Dragons' Incinerator](item_d0794681-844b-4ce8-9857-15320f35a634) adds a lot to your survivability during your Rally, also giving you higher Rally uptime, but doesn't add anything when you're not in Rally, as well as not giving you any [Ability Power](stat_ability_power). It's strong, but up to you whether it's worth it.

round_upgrades.notes: alt to Iridescent Iris if u can't afford it/want more survivability
ONLY take this if u have Lumerico Fusion Drive
you CAN take this early, but you'll end up with pretty low AP

rounds.notes:
Fast and powerful [Rally](ability_83c07ded-cfab-49cd-8318-1deaae4d8476)s with decent [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and near constant overhealth gain makes you a force to be reckoned with. 

---

### POWERS 
[Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee) and [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) have extra synergy you might not realize at first: Every time inspire is activated during rally by [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee), this counts as being triggered "by an ability", and so also nets you overhealth for doing nothing every 1.5 seconds, on top of everything else. 

Upping the power of your Rally even more while giving you overhealth throughout the game. Great! 

---

### ITEMS 
Now we can afford *both* [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) and [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e)! Probably, anyway.

Combining [LumériCo Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) and [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) means that even if you only have a tiny bit of armor as it restores itself, as you're hit it'll still give you that damage reduction. Given your good [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), you're likely to be using your abilities a lot, and so you should have at least some armor pretty often.

Though keep in mind, if all the enemies you're facing are going with [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), this becomes much less great, and you might want to swap [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) for another blue item instead.

Mostly we're upping our tankiness this round, so gameplay remains largely the same. 

---

[Dragon's Incinerator](item_d0794681-844b-4ce8-9857-15320f35a634) makes you incredibly difficult to kill during rally, especially if you're around multiple enemies and/or their tank. Trying to kill a Brig during rally with this can genuinely feel like attempting to kill a raid boss. 

*That being said,* however... it doesn't help you when you don't have your ult, so if you'd rather some more general survivability, then either [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) or [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) are good choices.

This full build can be nuts. Constant healing and overhealth with frequent powerful [Rally](ability_83c07ded-cfab-49cd-8318-1deaae4d8476)s can make it really rough for the enemy team to do much. 

---

### POWERS
None of the options here are bad, but they come with different strengths. 
- [Packstacker](item_87b99cde-3089-42fd-86bc-6e1ebf3fe422): Every pack now does more HoT, but as you deal ability damage with your shield boomerang, it'll extend even longer. This power makes it so that any ally with a pack on them gets a little icon over their head to let you know how long their pack is going to last for, I recommend going into the practice range with this full build to see how long you can make it, it's pretty wild. This is the "infinite packs" part of the build. 
- [Mender Bender](item_df95cea8-7040-4bfc-9145-8b820edce5a3): Heal your shield using bash and trigger inspire. Fun fact: due to the way [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) works, this will *always* give you overhealth, and if you hit someone with bash, it'll trigger twice. Not game-breaking, but neat! This power also gets better with [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b). 
- [Lindholm Wall](item_a733a6f5-72cd-43cd-a0fd-b1e03fa34753): Big shield = more survivability. Combine it with [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b) for around 2k barrier health during rally if you want to get silly with it. Obviously, if you're facing enemies focused on melee or that have shield piercing effects, this is significantly less good, as they don't care how beefy your barrier is, they'll hit you regardless. 

---

### ITEMS: 
The last two item slots can be filled with whichever of these items of your choosing, depending on your playstyle, power choice, and the game at hand: 
- [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce): The pure AP choice. More damage, more heals; nothing extra, but still good. 
- [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8): Less burst damage for you, and given you'll be healing yourself and getting overhealth pretty consistently, taking the damage over time instead isn't a bad trade.  
- [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b): Beefier shield! IDK if I'd recommend this with [Packstacker](item_87b99cde-3089-42fd-86bc-6e1ebf3fe422), but it works well with both of the other two power options.
- [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4): Survival option like [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8), but instead with a bigger health pool and conditional dmg resistance. 
- [Mitzi's Medicine](item_382d3dbd-63b8-453f-9be3-fefc3600dd24): This item is GREAT with [Packstacker](item_87b99cde-3089-42fd-86bc-6e1ebf3fe422), as with the much longer pack duration your teammates are more likely to benefit from the extra overhealth. Even with the other powers, the [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) is great for you. 
- [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d): Normally, unless you're taking constant damage I'd lean more towards taking [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4), but [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8)'s DoT stacks with [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d), so if you want pure survivability then taking both is a good option. 
- [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0): The "I'm broke :(" option. I still like this item. Even though purples are generally better, it's not bad.

round_upgrades.notes: the "I'm broke" option (not great facing high AP enemies, though)
